answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports the objective because it reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm, though it omits test duration and longer-term economics. Memories 44 and 73 show commercially relevant conversion, pipeline-quality, acquisition, and revenue effects, but do not establish sustained realized revenue or retention. Memory 31 reports a durable activation lift, yet provides no downstream revenue or customer-quality evidence. Memory 86 supports early adoption but omits durability and monetization. Memory 91 is weakest because it only reports week-one engagement and a nudge toward an early action, without quantified durability, qualification, retention, or revenue outcomes.
